meta.name: POSIX command sent to Windows PowerShell is rejected before approval, then corrected
meta.evidence: The Snake-game screenshots show a local model issuing a POSIX command (printf ... > file) on Windows, which cmd.exe rejects only after the user approved it. This fixture uses the other constructs named in the reliability brief (rm -rf, &&, mkdir -p) in the same position.
meta.notes: Reconstructed: the exact commands and the model's corrected second call.
meta.model_note: The model that produced the evidence is not known; 'unrecorded' is a placeholder name for the replay.

tool_calls.name: run_powershell
